lines: 耶稣叫齐了十二个门徒，
给他们能力、权柄，
制伏一切的鬼，医治各样的病，
He called the twelve together
and gave them power and authority over all demons
and to cure diseases.

耶穌叫齊了十二個門徒，
給他們能力、權柄，

He called the twelve together
and gave them power and authority over all demons
and to cure diseases.
And getting the twelve together
he gave them power and authority over all evil spirits and over diseases
to make them well.

But because of the desires of the flesh
let every man have his wife
